name: Can old plumbing handle new luxury fixtures?

mainEntity.name: Can older Los Angeles homes support modern luxury faucets, shower systems, and appliance fixtures without replacing the plumbing?
mainEntity.text: Can older Los Angeles homes support modern luxury faucets, shower systems, and appliance fixtures without replacing the plumbing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Older homes can sometimes support new luxury fixtures, but not always without adjustments. High-end faucets, rain showers, body sprays, tub fillers, and appliance connections may require more reliable pressure, correctly placed supply lines, and compatible rough-in dimensions. If the plumbing is old, corroded, undersized, or poorly routed, the new fixture may not perform as expected. In some cases, the visible upgrade also exposes hidden issues such as leaks, low pressure, valve incompatibility, or inadequate drainage. Before ordering fixtures, a qualified installer should inspect the existing supply lines, valve locations, wall depth, and shutoff access. That review helps avoid costly rework later. Homeowners should also ask whether the project needs pressure balancing, trim compatibility checks, or wall opening repairs. Luxury fixtures are only as good as the system behind them, so plumbing readiness matters as much as the product selection.
acceptedAnswer.description: Sometimes, but older plumbing often needs upgrades before high-end fixtures can be installed safely and correctly. Luxury fixtures may require better water pressure, updated shutoff valves, compatible rough-ins, and concealed waterproofing details. A site inspection should confirm whether the existing plumbing can support the new fixture set.
